keyEvents.text: Goal! Luton Town 1, Forest Green Rovers 0. Emilio Lawrence (Luton Town) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jordan Clark.
Ryan Rydel (Forest Green Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
George Johnston (Luton Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Luton Town 2, Forest Green Rovers 0. Jordan Clark (Luton Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Daniel Gore.
Brian Ifeanyi (Forest Green Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
